Name: 'Stealth'
Description: You turn into a crate, hidden to all but the most observant adventurers, also prevents movement since you have no legs.    This uses crate modifiers. Perfect for board players.

Name: Amphibimorph
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Transform enemies at target location into a frog, making them unable to attack or cast spells, and slowing their movement speed by 25% for 40 sec. While transformed into a frog the enemy is considered a Beast.    Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

Name: Ancient of Lore
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Funnel nature's energies into yourself, transforming into an Ancient of Lore for 20 sec.    While active, your stats are increased by 10% and nearby party members have their costs reduced by 30%.    While transformed, your movement speed is reduced by 50%.    Applies |CffffffffAncient Weariness|r to nearby party members, preventing them from benefiting from another Ancient form for 10 min.

Name: Ancient of War
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Funnel nature's fury into yourself, transforming into an Ancient of War for 20 sec.    While active, nearby party members have their critical strike chance increased by 20%.    While transformed, your movement speed is reduced by 50%.    Applies |CffffffffAncient Weariness|r to nearby party members, preventing them from benefiting from another Ancient form for 10 min.

Name: Backtrack
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Marks an enemy's location, yanking them back to the location after 3.50 sec.

Name: Bonds of Justice
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller  Send forth bonds of justice to an enemy, tethering them to you for 8 sec.  If the tether is broken through expiration or the target runs at least 10 yds from you, they are gripped back towards you, taking 33 Arcane damage.

Name: Build: Noise Box
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build a Noise Box for 15 sec that periodically unleashes screeching noise on nearby enemies, interrupting spellcasts and preventing spells of that school from being cast for 3 sec.

Name: Build: Repulsion Unit
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    Build a Repulsion Unit that periodically knocks back enemies within 6 yds every 5 sec for 20 sec.

Name: Bushcraft
Description: This spell belongs to Ranger    Gain the ability to craft Crude Leather from the Leather obtained from Skinning, gives you a chance to find it when Skinning beasts, and increases your Skinning speed.    Allows you to craft items that require Crude Leather.

Name: Chaos Rush
Description: This spell belongs to Felsworn    2 Charges, 10 sec recharge  Engulf yourself in fel energy and dash forward in the direction you are running.

Name: Crushing Dissonance
Description: This spell belongs to Cultist    Unleash a wave of maddening resonance, interrupting the current spell cast of all enemies around you and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 2 sec.

Name: Daring Escape
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Hunter    Jump backwards, causing all ranged attacks to miss you for 2 sec.

Name: Desynchronization
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Shift an enemy out of sync with the present, causing their grip to fail, disarming their melee and ranged weapons for 6 sec.    Upon removal, they are resynced, preventing them from regenerating their health for 6 sec.

Name: Dimensional Divergence
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Swap places with a target player.    If they're an enemy, you steal 80% of their movement speed for 3 sec.

Name: Dragon Leap
Description: This spell belongs to Pyromancer    Leap to a target location and come crashing down, dealing 29 Fire damage to up to 10 nearby enemies.

Name: Emerald Visage
Description: Summons a visage of an emerald drake unleashes a poisonous breath on enemies, dealing 10 Nature damage and an additional 5 Nature damage every second for 5 seconds.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Name: Entomb
Description: This spell belongs to Necromancer    Bury an enemy alive with necrotic energy, banishing them, preventing all actions and making them immune to damage for 4 sec.

Name: Flesh Hook
Description: Hook an enemy, pulling them to you, dealing 3 to 6 Physical damage and generating 10 rage.    This has a 45 sec cooldown when used versus players and Flesh Hook cannot be used against the same player for 30 sec.

Name: From Life Comes Death
Description: This spell belongs to Venomancer    For 20 sec, when you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor they now spawn a Big Mushroom beneath them. This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.    Big Mushroom Drop a Big Mushroom at target location that will explode after 2 sec.    When it explodes it deals 478 Nature damage to up to 12 enemies within 5 yds, piercing resistances and absorption effects.

Name: Gravity Bomb
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Place a gravity bomb on the target. After 6 sec they explode for 66 Chromatic damage in a 10 yds radius.    Directly before the explosion occurs, all enemies within 15 yds are teleported to the initial target.

Name: Guarding Rune
Description: This spell belongs to Runemaster    Inscribe a defensive rune beneath you in a 10 yd radius, summoning a barrier that causes allies within the radius to take 40% reduced Magic damage. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Halt
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Interrupt an enemy's current spell cast and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 3 sec.

Name: Hemostasis
Description: This spell belongs to Bloodmage    Trap an enemy in a blood orb, horrifying them in place for 4 sec.    Reactivating this ability within 4 sec, instantly pops the Hemostasis, dealing 143 Shadow damage and reducing their healing received by 60% for 10 sec.

Name: Malignant Jinx
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Curse an enemy for 8 sec, causing their next spell cast to silence them for 5 seconds.

Name: Mirage
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Become invisible for 20 sec, leaving a copy of yourself behind, teleporting forward, and reducing threat each second. Direct damage or healing done will end this effect.    While invisible, you can only see other invisible targets and those who can see invisible.    You may reactivate this ability within 5 sec to return to your initial location.

Name: Moonlit Slumber
Description: This spell belongs to Starcaller    Put an enemy to sleep for 30 sec. (10 seconds on players). Damage dealt will end the effect.

Name: Primal Totem
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Summon a totem that increases all stats of party and raid members by 1 within 40 yds for 30 sec.

Name: Rocket Boots
Description: This spell belongs to Tinker    3 Charges, 30 sec recharge  Activate your Rocket Boots launching you forwards.

Name: Roll Back
Description: This spell belongs to Chronomancer    Roll back time, dispelling the last harmful effect placed on an ally.    Subsequent uses increases the mana cost of this ability by 50% for 5 sec.

Name: Sever
Description: This spell belongs to Reaper    Attempt to drain an enemy's vitals, leeching 30 health, interrupting casting and preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 3 sec.

Name: Slither
Description: This spell belongs to Witch Doctor    Transform into a serpent, removing all movement impairing effects and increasing movement speed by 80% for 5 sec.  You cannot attack or cast spells, but chance to be hit by ranged attacks and spells is reduced by 100% for the duration.

Name: Spartan Kick
Description: A mighty kick that knocks your target back and deals 13 physical damage.    THIS IS SPARTA!

Name: Spirit Charge
Description: This spell belongs to Primalist    Charge to an ally's aid, healing them for 53 and dealing 67 Nature damage to enemies within 5 yds of them.

Name: Spite
Description: This spell belongs to Barbarian    Quickly unleash 3 ranged attacks at your target and then fling yourself back a great distance, dealing 125% Ranged Weapon Damage.

Name: Sun Gate
Description: This spell belongs to Sun Cleric    Shift 25 yds forward at light speed, removing all root effects.    This leaves behind a Sun Gate for 15 sec that allies can interact with to blink themselves the same distance forward. Allies can only use |CffffffffSun Gate|r every 1.50 min.

Name: The Eye of the Storm
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Mark an enemy for 4 sec. Every 1 sec, enemies near them take 21 Nature damage.    At the end of the duration, enemies near them also take 70 Nature damage and are rooted for 4 sec.

Name: Tranquil Circle
Description: This spell belongs to Templar    Place a holy circle on the ground at the target location for 4 sec, slowing enemy movement speed within by 70%.    Every 2 sec, enemies within the radius enter a tranquil state, falling asleep for 40 sec.

Name: Veilwalk
Description: This spell belongs to Reaper    2 Charges, 60 sec recharge  Move with spectral agility, gaining 50% increased movement speed for 5 sec.    Removes all movement impairing effects. Usable while stealthed.

Name: Wind Gate
Description: This spell belongs to Stormbringer    Place a Wind Gate at target location for 1 min.     You may cast Wind Gate: Evacuate on an ally to pull them to your Wind Gate.

Name: Absolute Hellfire
Description: Dealing damage with Flamestrike and Meteor marks the target for 3 sec.    Each tick of Rain of Fire triggers additional 1 Fire damage on the marked targets.    This uses Rain of Fire modifiers

Name: Alembic
Description: Being hit by a melee or ranged attack now has a 5% chance to grant you 20% of your base mana.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: An Honest Mistake
Description: Missing with a spell now increases your hit chance by 5% and spell haste by 5% for 10 sec.

Name: Arcane Reprisal
Description: Dealing damage with Arcane Barrage reduces the cooldowns of Crusader Strike and Divine Storm by 3 seconds.

Name: Archmage
Description: Increases the chance to trigger Missile Barrage and Brain Freeze by an additional 10%.

Name: Arugal's Blink
Description: Casting Blink unleashes a wave of Shadow Bolts at your arrival point, dealing 65 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Astral Fusion
Description: Dealing damage with Starfire or Wrath grants Astral Fusion.    Astral Fusion Reduces the cast time of your next Starsurge by 34% and increases its damage by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 8 sec.  Reaching 3 stacks resets the cooldown of Starsurge.

Name: Astral Realm
Description: Dealing damage with Thunderstorm restores an additional 10% of your maximum mana.    If a target player is afflicted by your Unrelenting Storm when damaged by Thunderstorm, you and your target are forced into an alternate dimension for 8 seconds, reducing the target's damage and healing by 20%.

Name: Battle Glaive
Description: Using 3 Warrior direct damaging abilities in quick succession resets the cooldown of Glaive Toss and increases the damage of your next Glaive Toss by 40%. Lasts 10 sec.  Does not work with 'on next swing' abilities.

Name: Biting Drain
Description: Grants the periodic damage from your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells the ability to critically hit.    Critical strike damage bonus of your Drain Life and Drain Soul is increased by 35%.

Name: Blaze Ward
Description: Taking direct damage or avoiding attacks has a chance to activate Blaze Aura.    Blaze Aura Ignites the area surrounds you, causing 5 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 5 sec. Causes a high amount of threat.

Name: Blaze
Description: Your Fire Blast spreads your Immolate to enemies within 10 yards. The spread Immolate cannot critically strike.

Name: Blessing of the Divines
Description: Your direct Holy and Nature heals now have a 10% chance to trigger a random blessing.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec and can only trigger from heals with a resource cost.    Blessing of the Titan Increases the target's Health by 5% and reduces damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.    Blessing of Creation Grants 12 mana, 22 energy, and 10 rage to you and your party.    Blessing of Time Increases you and your target's spell haste by 10% for 10 sec.    Blessing of Mending Heals party members within 30 yards of you -39.    Blessing of the Divines Heals party members within 30 yards of you for -30 every 3 seconds for 15 sec.

Name: Bloodstained Recklessness
Description: Killing an enemy during Recklessness extends its duration by 3 seconds.    This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Bloody Business
Description: Casting Mangle 3 times within 5 sec, spreads your Pounce to up to 7 nearby targets.

Name: Bloody Claws
Description: Claw costs 12 less energy and gains additional damage equal to 20% of your attack power.

Name: Boomer
Description: Direct damage Fire spells have a chance to cause an explosion around you, dealing -15 and increase your spell critical strike chance by 3% for 5 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 8 sec.

Name: Brilliance of Faith
Description: Divine Favor now empowers the cast and further empowers 2 casts of the spell that consumed it.  Holy Shock - Has no cooldown and has its global cooldown reduced by 33%.  Flash of Light - Heals up to 3 targets.  Holy Light - Heals for 30% more.

Name: Cat-a-clysmic Entrance
Description: Casting Searing Pain now grants you Cat-a-Clysmic Entrance for 10 sec. While at 5 stacks your next Cat Form shapeshift has no global cooldown and unleashes Cat-a-clysm.    Cat-a-clysm Deals 41 Fire damage to 6 enemies within 8 yards, increasing your Fire damage dealt to them by 20% for 10 sec.

Name: Cataclysmic Sundering
Description: Sundering leaves a burning patch on the ground for 8 sec. Dealing 118 Fire damage to enemies every second and increasing the damage of your Flame shock by 50%.

Name: Celestial Fury
Description: Critical strikes with Wrath while Nature's Grace is active grant you Celestial Fury.   Celestial Fury Your next direct Arcane spell deals 5, increased by 20% per stack, additional Arcane damage to nearby enemies. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: Celestial Replenishment
Description: Triggering an Eclipse now restores 16% of your missing mana.

Name: Charged Tides
Description: Casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or triggering Lightning Rod grants you Charged Tides.      Charged Tides Your next Chain Heal or Healing Wave deals 10% increased healing and has a 25% reduced cast time. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Clarity of the Mind
Description: Your Omen of Clarity talent has an additional 4% chance to activate.

Name: Clean Pass
Description: Your Glaive Toss consumes your Piercing Shots bleed to deal its full damage increased by 100%.

Name: Cleanse In Flames
Description: Exorcism, Judgement, Hammer of Wrath and Holy Shock deal 10% increased damage to targets afflicted by your Holy Fire.

Name: Coldshot
Description: Hunter shots reduce the cast time of your next Ray of Frost by 15%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec.

Name: Collective Conscious
Description: Your Tranquility also restores 15% base mana when it heals.

Name: Combat Medic
Description: Your Bandage now grows more effective with each heal, increasing the healing your ally receives from Bandage by 10%, stacks up to 8 times.

Name: Consecrated Zeal
Description: Dealing damage with Consecration grants you a stack of Consecrated Zeal.    Consecrated Zeal Increases holy damage done by 1% and reduces physical damage taken by 1%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 3 sec.

Name: Consuming Flames
Description: Increases the potency of your Ignite talent by an additional 15%, but your Fire critical strikes deal 5% less damage.

Name: Corrupting Shadows
Description: Your Shadowburn applies Corruption to the target.

Name: Covering Crown
Description: Requires  Path of Healing  Casting Rejuvenation now grants your target Covering Crown.    Covering Crown Reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by 30% for 3 sec. This does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Creeping Frost
Description: Your Deep Freeze now spawns creeping frost beneath the target that grows in size every second and reduces enemy movement speed by 40%.

Name: Cursed Arrows
Description: Ranged auto attacks have a 10% chance to curse the target, when that target dies it summons a skeletal guardian to fight for you.

Name: Dark Arrows
Description: Dealing damage with Shadow Bolt or Seed of Corruption now grants you Dark Arrows.    Dark Arrows Your next 5 Auto Shots fire a Dark Arrow dealing 100% ranged weapon damage as Shadow and restoring 2% of your maximum mana. Lasts 15 seconds.

Name: Dark Intent
Description: Dealing damage with Sinister Strike, Eviscerate, Garrote, Rupture, Crimson Tempest, Shiv, Ambush and Gloomblade now deals 10 additional Shadow damage.  If the ability critically strikes, the additional Shadow damage is also a critical hit.

Name: Dark Reclamation
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul or casting Life Tap grants you Dark Reclamation.      Dark Reclamation Reduces the cooldown of your next Shadowburn by 1 seconds.   Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Deathbringer
Description: Dealing damage with single-target spells and abilities deals an additional 7 Shadow damage.    This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Demonic Burst
Description: Your Demonic Leap now sends out a Blast Wave, dealing 6 Fire damage, knocking enemies back, and granting you Bursting Power.    Bursting Power Increases your damage done by 5%. Lasts 3 sec.

Name: Desperation
Description: Bloodthirst now deals an additional strike dealing up to 33% damage based on your missing health.

Name: Destructive Bargain
Description: Each cast of Incinerate or Soul Fire empowers your Incinerate, Soul Fire and Beam of Hatred:   - Increasing the damage dealt against monsters by 5%   - Reducing the casting speed by 3%   - Reducing the global cooldown by 5%   - Increasing the mana cost by 70%    These effects stack up to 5 times and last 9 sec.

Name: Doppelganger
Description: Your Vanish now spawns a Doppelganger that looks like you and runs in a random direction, taking the hits so you can get away. Lasts 4 sec.

Name: Double-clawed
Description: Increases the periodic damage of Rip and Rake by 60% and their duration by 3 sec.

Name: Draining Strikes
Description: Dealing damage with single target spells and abilities heals you for 3.    This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Duck Hunting
Description: Your damaging abilities and Auto Shots against enemies 5 yards above you now dispel Slow Fall and deal an additional strike for 3% of the original damage.

Name: Duelist
Description: Using Taunt on a player now plants a dueling flag at their location, reducing their movement speed by 30% for 6 sec if they flee the area.

Name: Echoed Incinerate
Description: Casting Incinerate has a 30% chance to trigger Echoed Incinerate.       Echoed Incinerate Deals -13 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25 to 29 Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.    Scales with Incinerate modifiers.

Name: Echoing Power
Description: Your Shaman Shock spells grant you a boon:    Earth Shock: Reduces your Physical damage taken by 4% and increases threat generated from Nature sources by 8%.    Frost Shock: Reduces the target's attack power by 2, reduces your damage taken by 2%, and increases threat generated from Frost sources by 8%.    Flame Shock: Grants you a shield that deals Fire damage to melee attackers, reduces your magic damage taken by 3%, and increases threat generated from Fire sources by 8%.    Attack power reduction does not stack with similar effects.

Name: Electrified Grasp
Description: The electrified area left behind by your Stormbringer now slows enemies inside it by 25%.

Name: Elemental Energy
Description: Your Earth Shock, Flame Shock and Frost Shock now grant 20 energy.

Name: Energized Judgement
Description: While below 40 energy you gain Energized Judgements.    Energized Judgement Increases the damage of your Judgements by 75%.    Judgements deal 25% increased damage against players.

Name: Energizing Prayer
Description: When Desperate Prayer restores you to full health, it also replenishes 25% of your total mana.

Name: Envenomed
Description: Deal 10% additional damage with Rogue poisons to bleeding targets.

Name: Erupting Void
Description: Triggering your Backlash talent now rips a hole in the void, knocking back nearby enemies and slowing them by 50% for 4 sec. Backlash cooldown is increased by 100%.

Name: Explosive Entrance
Description: Casting Blink now unleashes an explosion at your arrival point, dealing 111 Fire damage to nearby enemies and resets the cooldown of your Blast Wave.

Name: Faith Rekindled
Description: Each time your Renew heals a target they receive Faith.    Faith All healing received increased by 1% and healing received from your Renew increased by 5%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 4 sec.

Name: Fatal Vanguard
Description: Increases the critical strike chance and critical strike damage bonus of Execute by 35%.    Critically striking with Execute reduces the cooldown of Concussion Blow by 2 seconds.

Name: Favour of the Soulflayer
Description: Using Hunger for Blood now consumes Bathe in Blood to trigger Favour of the Soulflayer.      Favour of the Soulflayer Causes Physical damage to all nearby enemies within 8 yards, increased by consuming your Bathe in Blood stacks.     Increases your Physical critical damage bonus by 30% and Crimson Tempest now benefits from haste and has the ability to critically hit. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Fiery Bash
Description: Dealing damage with Shield Slam, Shield of Righteousness or Interrupting an enemy with Shield Bash now unleashes a Fiery Bash.      Fiery Bash Deals 6 Fire damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies. Causes them to burn for 2 Fire damage every second and increases your fire damage dealt to them by 10% for 4 sec.

Name: Fired Up
Description: Dealing direct Fire damage now has a 12% chance to cause your next Fire spell or ability to be a guaranteed critical strike.

Name: Flame Nova
Description: Fire Nova now explodes from up to 4 targets affected by your Flame Shock, but the additional explosions deal 50% less damage.

Name: Flashpoint
Description: Dealing damage with Explosive Shot increases the critical strike chance of your next Pyroblast by 8%. Stacks up to 6. Lasts 20 seconds.

Name: Fleeting Shadow
Description: Using Garrote, Cheap Shot or Ambush from Stealth allows you to use Ambush outside of stealth for 2.5 sec.

Name: Frozen Munitions
Description: Hunter attacks grant you a stack of Frozen Munitions. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 20 sec.      Frozen Munitions Consumes up to 3 stacks to empower your next Frozen Orb, Frostbolt or Ice Lance. Consuming additional stacks increases the effect.    Frozen Orb - Direct damage increased by 20%.    Frostbolt - 34% reduced cast time, and 50% increased damage against monsters.    Ice Lance - Deals 50% increased damage, and its global cooldown is reduced to 1 sec.

Name: Fury of the Wind
Description: Your Windfury attacks now unleash furious winds, dealing 40% weapon damage to 5 nearby enemies.

Name: Glacial Light
Description: Dealing Holy or Frost damage against enemies burning from your Holy Fire now reduces the cooldown of Icy Veins by 7 second.

Name: Goldrinn's Guile
Description: Your finishing moves now have a 5% chance per combo point to grant you Goldrinn's Guile, increased to 20% chance per combo point if you are in Worgen Form.      Goldrinn's Guile Your next Mind Blast or Vampiric Touch is instant, has 40% increased damage, and grants 2 combo points. Lasts for 8 sec.

Name: Goremaw's Bite
Description: Damaging rogue finishing moves have a 3% chance per combo point consumed to trigger Goremaw's Bite.      Goremaw's Bite Your next damaging Rogue finishing move causes Goremaw to lash out, dealing 57 Shadow damage and generating 5 combo points.

Name: Grasping Curse
Description: Your Shadow Bolt damage now applies Grasping Curse.    This effect can only occur once every 5 sec.    Grasping Curse Reduces the target's movement speed by 35% for 5 sec.    This uses Curse of Exhaustion modifiers.

Name: Guardians of the Grove
Description: Your Treants heal allies below 90% health using all of your known Druid healing spells, except Tranquility. Treants no longer deal damage and have 66% reduced health.  In battlegrounds or arenas, Treants only use instant-cast Druid healing spells.

Name: Hammerdin
Description: Damaging Paladin damaging abilities have a 20% chance to summon a Hammer from the Heavens and reduce the cooldown of Hour of Judgement by 4 seconds.    Hammer from the Heavens A Holy hammer falls from the heavens, dealing 17 to -19 Holy damage to nearby enemies.

Name: Hastened Feint
Description: Reduces the cooldown of your Feint ability by 4 seconds.

Name: Heat Burst
Description: Dealing Magic damage against enemies affected by your Conflagrate now deals an additional 66 Fire damage.  This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

Name: Hellish Pursuit
Description: Dealing damage with Hellfire reduces the cooldown of Burning Rush by 1.5 seconds.

Name: High Winds
Description: When your Cyclone ends, the target's damage and healing are reduced by 20% for 4 sec.

Name: Holy Chains
Description: Your Holy Fire now shackles the target with heavy chains, reducing their movement speed by 70% for 3 sec.

Name: Holy Hammer Nova
Description: Casting Holy Nova now reduces the active cooldown of Light's Hammer by 2 seconds.

Name: Holy Surge
Description: Holy Shock deals 50% increased damage against monsters.    Dealing damage with Holy Shock grants you Surge of Light.    This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.    Surge of Light Your next Smite or Flash Heal is instant and costs no mana. It cannot critically hit. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Howl of Winter
Description: Cone of Cold now grants you Howl of Winter.    Howl of Winter Increases the damage of your next Deep Freeze by 35%. Stacks up to 4 times and lasts 15 sec.

Name: I Have The High Ground
Description: Deal an additional strike for 3% original damage when you have the high ground, being 5 yards above your target.

Name: Icebound Ancestry
Description: Your attacks ignore Armor against Frozen targets.

Name: Indomitable
Description: Unlocked by  Tactical Mastery (Rank 3)  While Stagger is active your healing taken is increased by 10%.    Does not stack with other similar effects.

Name: Inescapable Roots
Description: Your Entangling Roots become inescapable, preventing enemies from breaking free during the first half of their duration, but are now more susceptible to breaking from damage.

Name: Inevitable Decimation
Description: Casting Incinerate or Chaos Bolt 3 times within 5 sec reduces the cast time and global cooldown of your Soul Fire by 50%. Lasts 8 sec. Does not stack with Decimation.

Name: Inferno
Description: Enemies hit by your Hellfire now have a chance to trigger an additional Hellfire explosion.

Name: Inner Hunt
Description: Non-hunter melee abilities grant Inner Hunt.    This effect can only occur once every 8 sec and only from abilities that trigger the global cooldown.    Inner Hunt Your next Mongoose Bite and Counterattack deals 60% increased damage, ignores 60% of the target's armor and does not trigger its cooldown. Lasts for 15 sec.    Mongoose Bite and Counterattacks damage is increased by 25% versus players.

Name: Jab Cross
Description: Dealing damage with Devastate increases the critical strike chance and damage of your next 2 spells or abilities by 10%.

Name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
Description: Your Judgements now grant 30 rage and cause your next Execute to ignore 100% of the target's armor.

Name: Kindles for Holy Fire
Description: Dealing direct damage with Fire spells and abilities grants you Kindles for Holy Fire.      Kindles for Holy Fire Increases the direct damage of your next Holy Fire by 20%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts for 15 sec.

Name: Lightning Discharge
Description: While casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, your Lightning Shield deals double damage and releases pure energy, stunning nearby enemies for 2.50 sec.    This effect can only occur once every 20 sec.

Name: Locust Ranger
Description: When Steady Shot hits a target stung by your Serpent Sting it triggers your Wild Quiver talent.

Name: Lycan Claws
Description: Dealing damage with Rake, Rip, Pounce or Arugal's Gift now has a 100% chance to deal an additional 2 Shadow damage and grants you Mind Shock.    Lycan Claws deal 100% increased damage while in Worgen Form.    Mind Shock Resets the cooldown of Mind Blast and your next Mind Blast costs no mana and has no cooldown.

Name: Madness of the Old Gods
Description: Summoning Tentacle of the Old Gods grants you Madness of the Old Gods.    Madness of the Old Gods Whispers of madness increase all damage done by 5%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Maelstrom
Description: Dealing damage with Lightning Overload from Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning grants one stack of Maelstrom. Dealing damage with Stormstrike and Lava Burst grants two.      Maelstrom Upon reaching 40 stacks, casting Earth Shock grants Unleashed Maelstrom.    Unleashed Maelstrom Your critical strikes from Lava Burst, direct Shaman Nature damage spells and abilities shock the target for an additional 70% of your spell's damage.

Name: Massacre
Description: Killing Spree applies Massacre to all targets hit.  Killing an enemy that grants experience or honor decreases the cooldown of Killing Spree by 10 seconds.    Massacre Increases your damage dealt to the target by 3%, stacks up to 5 times and lasts 15 sec.    Deals 1% increased damage against players

Name: Master's Meatshield
Description: Your Drain Life also heals your Tamed Pet.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin or Tether Elemental, and Tame Beast.

Name: Molten Ammo
Description: Explosive Shot empowers Steady Shot, Multi-Shot, and Aimed Shot causing them to deal extra Fire damage for 5 sec.

Name: Molten Outburst
Description: Dealing damage to an enemy standing in your Earthquake with a non-instant Fire spell causes an eruption, dealing 6 Fire damage to nearby enemies and knocking players into the air.    This effect can only occur once every 10 sec.

Name: Momentum
Description: Grappling Hook now grants you Momentum.    Momentum Your movement speed is increased by 40% and the damage of your Rogue abilities is increased by 10% for 6 sec.

Name: Natural Energy
Description: Your Mutilate critical strikes restore 5 energy and an additional 10 energy over 3 sec.

Name: Natural Selection
Description: Casting Sinister Strike, Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge extends the duration of Insect Swarm on your target by 1.5 seconds.    This can occur up to 15 times before this effect goes on 15 sec cooldown.    Additionally, Insect Swarm now benefits from spell haste.

Name: New Moon
Description: Damaging non-instant spell casts increase the duration of your Moonfire by 1 sec.

Name: Northern Winds
Description: Frost Shock increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec, but no longer slows your target.

Name: On the Hunt
Description: Increases the duration of Mend Pet by 6 sec. Mend Pet increases the damage of your Tamed Pet by 15%.  Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.

Name: Overwhelming Rage
Description: Your maximum rage is increased by 100.

Name: Power Overwhelming
Description: Dealing direct damage with spells and abilities now reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Power and Presence of Mind by 1.5 seconds.    This can only occur from abilities that trigger the global cooldown.

Name: Purification By Light
Description: Your direct weapon damage based spells and abilities now have a chance to exorcise the target, dealing 31 Holy damage and consecrating the ground beneath them, dealing 5 Holy damage to enemies in the area every second for 8 sec.    This uses Exorcism and Consecration modifiers

Name: Quick Burn
Description: Your melee strikes have a chance to grant you Quick Burn.    Quick Burn The cast time of your next Mana Burn is reduced by 75%. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Radiant Renewal
Description: Reduces the mana cost of Renew by 50% and increases its periodic healing by 20%.

Name: Raging Momentum
Description: Using Death Wish, Hunger for Blood, Bloodrage, Recklessness, Berserker Rage or Bestial Wrath will now randomly reduce the cooldown of one of the other abilities by 3 seconds.    Abilities can be chosen even if they're not on cooldown or known.

Name: Raging Onslaught
Description: Raging Blow deals 40% increased damage, and has a 20% chance to refund a charge.

Name: Raging Riptide
Description: Casting Healing Rain will trigger 139 Nature healing on all targets affected by your Riptide.

Name: Rapid Bloodthirst
Description: Reduces the global cooldown of Bloodthirst by 33%.

Name: Rapid Shatter
Description: You can now immediately follow-up Frostbolt while it is still in the air with another Mage spell, increasing its damage done by 45%.

Name: Raptured Essence
Description: The mana returned to you from your Rapture is increased by 100%.

Name: Renewed Through Absolution
Description: Penance now consumes your Renew to heal your target for an additional 92.    This heal uses Penance heal modifiers.

Name: Righteous Zealot
Description: Your direct damaging spells and abilities now have a 30% chance to Smite your target, dealing 17 additional Holy damage and healing nearby party members for 23.    This damage uses Smite modifiers and can only occur once every 4.5 sec. Deals 80% damage and healing when triggered against enemy players.

Name: Ripping Tempest
Description: Increases the duration of Crimson Tempest by 4 seconds, and its damage by 40%.

Name: Sawed Off Barrel
Description: Your Multi-shot knocks your primary target back, or knocks you back when fired in the air. Multi-shot's range is reduced by 15 yards and the cooldown is doubled.

Name: Servant of the Old Gods
Description: Casting Gloomblade forces your Tentacles of the Old Gods to smash towards your target, dealing 27 Shadow damage.     This effect can only occur once every 3 sec.

Name: Shaken
Description: Casting Fear causes your target to become Shaken.      Shaken All stats are reduced by 5% and movement speed is reduced by 25%. Every 3 sec, nearby enemies become Shaken. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Shapeshift Specialist
Description: Shapeshifting cost is reduced by 20%.

Name: Shapeshifter's Aim
Description: Using Mangle grants you Shapeshifter's Aim.      Shapeshifter's Aim Increases the damage of your hunter shots by 30%. Lasts 15 sec.

Name: Shapeshifter's Fangs
Description: Hunter shots grant you Shapeshifter's Fangs.    Shapeshifter's Fangs Damage of your next direct Cat ability is increased by 50%. Max 3 charges. Lasts 8 sec.

Name: Shield of Wrath
Description: Your Avenger's Shield cooldown is reduced by 40%, but it no longer slows enemies or jumps to additional targets.  Does not work with Shield of the Templar.

Name: Shrouded in Shrapnel
Description: Dealing damage with Colossus Smash now increases your armor by 5% for 8 sec and taking damage from Stagger reduces the active cooldown of Colossus Smash by 4 second.

Name: Skull Crusher
Description: Your Slam reduces the cooldown of Death Wish by 1 second.

Name: Sniper
Description: Standing still for 3 seconds grants you Sniper.    Sniper Increases the range of your Aimed Shot and Kill Shot by 1 yards and increases their damage dealt by 4%. Moving removes the stacks. Stacks up to 10 times.

Name: Soul Void
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul now applies Soul Void. Reaching 10 stacks applies Withered Soul, causing your Drain Life to deal 75% more damage. Lasts 15 sec.     Enemies with Withered Soul do not gain Soul Void.

Name: Soulbender
Description: Dealing damage with Drain Soul or casting Life Tap grants you Soul Energy.    Soul Energy Your next Shadowburn heals nearby allies and converts all Soul Energy into Soul Mending. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts 10 sec.    Soul Mending Increases your healing done by 2% per stack of Soul Energy consumed. Lasts 10 sec.

Name: Spartan Smash
Description: Dealing damage with Javelin applies Skewered. Dealing damage with Shield Slam increases Skewered stacks on affected targets.    Skewered Your next Siegebreaker deals 20% increased damage to the target and resets the cooldown of your Javelin. Stacks up to 10 times and lasts for 12 sec.

Name: Spectre
Description: You deal 10% increased periodic damage while stealthed.

Name: Stormbringer
Description: Your direct damaging spells and abilities now have a chance to unleash lightning, dealing 3 Nature damage to your target and electrifying the ground, dealing an additional 12 Nature damage to nearby enemies every second for 4 seconds.

Name: Taste of Success
Description: Victory Rush grants you Taste of Success and deals 10% additional damage.    Taste of Success Your physical damage taken from the next attack is reduced by 60%.

Name: Temple Guardian
Description: While Inner Fire is active you gain an additional 5% block chance.

Name: Tesla Coil Collar
Description: Casting damaging Nature abilities now grants you Charged, which can be consumed by Earth Shock at 5 stacks to grant your Tamed Pet Tesla Coil Collar.    Tamed Pet includes Summoned Demon, Enslave Demon, Dominate Undead, Tame Dragonkin, Tether Elemental, Summoned Ghoul, and Tame Beast.    Tesla Coil Collar Overcharged, granting your Tamed Pet 3% mana, 10% energy, and focus every second while releasing lightning pulses that deals 100% weapon damage plus 20 Nature damage to nearby enemies. Lasts for 3 sec.

Name: Thousand Cuts
Description: Dealing damage with Hurricane now increases your Poison and Bleed damage by 7%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 12 sec.

Name: Thunderburst
Description: Thunder Clap and Execute have a 35% chance to strike the target with a thunderbolt causing 8 high threat Nature damage.

Name: Thunderlord
Description: While affected by Avatar your chance to trigger Thunderburst is increased by 25%.    Dealing Nature damage with spells grants Thunderlord.      Thunderlord Increases the damage of your next Concussion Blow by 10%. Stacks 10 times. Lasts 10 seconds.

Name: Timed Charge
Description: Returning with Alter Time causes energy from the time rift to explode, dealing 456 Arcane damage and stunning nearby enemies for 3 sec.

Name: Totem Master: Fire
Description: Your Fire Totems now gain 15% of your health, but their mana cost is increased by 200%.    Your Magma totem lasts 30% longer.

Name: Tribal Rage
Description: Your melee criticals reduce the cooldown of Shamanistic Rage by 1 seconds.    Your direct damaging spell criticals extend the duration of Shamanistic Rage by 1 seconds.

Name: Troll Sweat
Description: Killing a player gives you a permanent stack of troll sweat. This tells heroes how sweaty you are. All sweat is lost on death. Accumulate enough sweat and reap the rewards.   If it Troll Sweats it Troll Sweats.

Name: Turning Tides
Description: For each enemy hit by your Typhoon the duration of your Riptide is increased by 4 seconds.

Name: Twin Fangs
Description: Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Counterattack have a 50% chance to trigger Twin Fang, dealing 100% of the damage dealt as Physical damage.    Requires one-handed weapons and a weapon equipped in your off hand.

Name: Twist of Faith
Description: Using Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Command, Seal of Vengeance, Seal of Fervor, or Seal of Arcane Wrath while a different one of these seals is already active grants you the previously active seal for 10 sec.  These seals cost no mana but have a 10 second cooldown.

Name: Unseen Assassin
Description: For 3 sec after leaving Stealth or activating Shadow Dance, your Glaive Toss, Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss only triggers a 0.5 sec global cooldown and deal 40% increased damage against monsters.    Deadly Throw and Shuriken Toss deal 30% reduced damage against players whilst affected by Unseen Assassin

Name: Unstoppable Force
Description: Your Slam is now guaranteed to critically hit when used on an Incapacitated or Immobilized target.

Name: Void Teleportation
Description: Using Void Shift also swaps the position of the caster and the target.

Name: Voidblade
Description: Shadow spells increase the damage of your combo point generating Rogue abilities by 3% and Dark Intent by additional 3%. Stacks up to 3.   Rogue combo point generating abilities have a chance to increase the damage taken from your Shadow Word: Pain by 80% for 8 sec.  The duration of Voidblade is not refreshable at max stacks.

Name: Waking Nightmare
Description: Your Haunt applies Waking Nightmare to the target. When that target is healed, the healer is afflicted with Phantom Nightmare.    Phantom Nightmare You deal 10% increased Shadow damage to the target. Fear effects last 50% longer against them.

Name: Waning Moon
Description: Dealing periodic damage with Moonfire grants you Waning Moon. This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.    Waning Moon Reduces the cast time of your next Arcane Blast or Starfire by 10%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 10 sec.

Name: Whirl of Rage
Description: Dealing damage with Whirlwind now grants you Bloodrage.    Bloodrage Generates 20 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.    This ability is usable while shapeshifted.    It also grants you Enrage if known.    Enrage Physical damage increased by 10%. Haste increased by 10%.

Name: Words of Time
Description: Your Borrowed Time is no longer consumed when casting.
